g.text: Roadmap
Next
Why it waits
Daily on-chain root of the live registry check
The watcher already writes to ClaimRegistry; a daily summary
root would make the live feed tamper-evident too
Gold Standard in the live check
Its public registry needs its own reader
Report reader: a language model proposes Scope 1 figures
with page and table row from company PDFs, a person
confirms
Speeds up coverage; every figure must still be checked against
the rendered page
Name suggestions on the site
About one in five suggestions on real names was wrong;
published only after manual review
More registries (ACR, CAR, ART, national registries)
Same three-signal rules need their project types
Plant-level EU ETS data for utilities without a group report
Read from the EU registry, linked per plant
